missable_intro: Seven trophies have a closing window. Everything else can be earned after the story, in free roam, at your own pace — these seven cannot be left to the end.

steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing, then Chapters 1 to 4 in order — each chapter trophy pops at its chapter's end.
Do the named story missions as they come: Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory.
BEFORE the final mission: earn Hot Together and Retail Therapy with your partner, smash out of a vehicle showroom for Capital Offense, and play the partner activities for Personal Best.
Finish the final mission for the gold trophy. Story trophies are unmissable — missions can be replayed — so nothing here can be lost except the partner window above.
stages.title: The story — play it through

steps: Finish each character's strand to its last mission: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Complete 8 stranger strands in total — the five named characters plus three more from the question-mark markers across Leonida.
Hunt the unique animal for Bret as part of his strand.
Side strands stay open after the story, so this stage can run any time — but it is best done right after the finale, while the map is fresh.
stages.title: Strangers & side strands

steps: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — drive the state edge to edge and watch the area counter.
Meditate at all 18 spots; log WAiNK It at 100 locations as you pass them.
Complete 3 collectible card sets; discover 100 vehicles; buy all 8 garage properties.
Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, and have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
Do this stage in one long sweep: every collectible here is a count, and counts only go up.
stages.title: Leonida, explored — collectibles

steps: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, then win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations and 20 different races.
Try all 9 activity types once; complete an arcade game; bowl a full game at Kolt & Associates.
Farm the counters: 250 stunts, 50 challenges, 5 bank vaults, one armored truck, one illegal operation per gang (9).
Beat Cal at fishing, rob a jewelry store undetected, take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus, leave VCIA unscheduled, and land a melee drive-by.
The Rhinos trophy needs a top wanted level — save it for a session where you can afford the chaos.
stages.title: Activities & the long grind

steps: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts and spend $100,000 across all shops — both counters close during the robbery grind.
Make choices at every prompt (500 tracked) and, on a short mission, fail once then pass on the immediate retry.
Keep exploring odd locations and stranger markers until the strange event finds you.
When the last box ticks, 100% Completion pops — and the platinum, Vice Got a Price!, lands with it.
stages.title: Money, choices & the platinum

subtitle: Five stages, built from the official descriptions: which story chapters and missions, which collectibles and counts, in what order. Do the missables in stage 1 before the finale — they are the only trophies with a closing window.
title: Roadmap to the platinum
